submissions.description: Enterprise lead applications and contact requests submitted through the Glamourtech portal

name.description: Full name of the contact or applicant

email.description: Business email address of the applicant

role.description: Job role or title (for home form submissions)

country.description: Country of residence or company headquarters (for contact form submissions)

description.description: Project description or bottleneck description provided by the user

formType.description: The specific form used to submit: 'home' or 'contact'

createdAt.description: The Firestore server timestamp when the submission was recorded
